prerequisites: Knowledge of OSI model physical, data link, network, and transport layers

learning_outcomes.text: Know the methods of network routing and interconnection.
Design and develop network interconnection applications, as well as analyze and interpret their results.
Analyze and evaluate routing protocols using computer tools.
Create and use models of real networks using network simulators.
Use congestion control techniques to correctly plan and dimension networks.

assessment_rules: For ordinary and extraordinary calls, the final grade is calculated as 0.7 x TE + 0.3 x PL, provided both TE and PL are at least 5 out of 10. If any part is not passed, the final grade will be 4.5 points. Grades for passed blocks are saved between calls of the same academic year. The differentiated evaluation follows the same terms as the conventional evaluation.
